schematic human figures with linear anatomy
arms/hands rendered as simple splayed lines

justification: Both are upright slabs bearing schematic low-relief human imagery with linear limbs, garment-like vertical striations and loop/disc ornaments across the chest area, which is a moderately specific convergence in body ornament placement. However, A depicts multiple small figures in registers interacting in a narrative scene, while B is a single monumental frontal figure with a hat/headdress whose body fills the whole stone, so the compositional relationships differ substantially.
